caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object appears to be an iron trivet or a similar cast iron item, roughly triangular in shape with rounded edges and a flat base. It is rendered in shades of dark gray and black, giving it a metallic, worn appearance. The surface of the trivet features inscriptions in raised lettering along the curved upper edge, reading “COLEBROOKDALE IRON CO. POTTSTOWN PA.” The interior of the object contains a symmetrical, decorative cut-out design that includes three arches forming a pattern and a central shield-like detail with an abstract, cross-topped element in the middle. Two circular holes are present, one at the top and one at the bottom of the object. The artist’s name, “Violet Oakley,” is written in small script at the lower right of the drawing.
title: Trivet
